states.valuation: convertToAssets(leftShares) via the out-of-range index path (calculateExitedAssets with type(uint256).max returns leftShares = full queued shares, exitedAssets = 0)

groundTruth: calculateExitedAssets(holder, ticket, timestamp, idx).exitedAssets + (leftShares > 0 ? convertToAssets(leftShares) : 0), read live at each forkBlock; idx = getExitQueueIndex(ticket) (or type(uint256).max when -1).
trustModel: Mutable coordinate-only cache (ADR 0014); owner submits (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples, adapter values from live reads. calculateExitedAssets(receiver=account) is the on-chain ownership check (wrong tuple → 0). VaultsRegistry membership checked at submit time. Owner can under-report only, never over-report.
